_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit. Each command has a fixed argv and an ordered map of validated params. The server appends each declared param's value (and its optional flag) to argv in declared order. Regexes are fullmatch — anything that doesn't fully match is rejected with HTTP 400.

say._doc: Multi-param example with one required and one optional flagged param. Trigger: GET /run/say?message=hello&voice=Alex&token=…

restart-container._doc: Restart a docker container by name, restricted to a known set via regex. Trigger: GET /run/restart-container?name=crowdsec&token=…
